exposure: parental history of type 1 and type 2 diabetes
outcome: prevalence of parental diabetes (type 1 and type 2)
genotype frequencies of ABCC8 and KCNJ11 polymorphisms
cohort: 1101 Saudi pregnant women and their newborns
finding: GDM was not associated with NDM in this cohort of Saudi neonates, and while one neonate carried a homozygous mutant form of the KCNJ11 gene, larger studies are needed to establish the role of KCNJ11 and ABCC8 variants in neonatal and postnatal diabetes.
